content: The ever growing use of machine learning in science has been enabled by several progresses among which the exponential growth of data available. The quality of a system now depends mostly on the quality and quantity of the data it has been trained on. If it does not discard the importance of an appropriate architecture, it reaffirms the fact that rich and large corpora are a valuable resource. Corpora are research contributions which do not only allow to save and observe certain phenomena or validate a hypothesis or model, but are also a mandatory part of the technology development. This trend is notably observable within the NLP field, where industrial technologies, such as Apple, Amazon or Google vocal assistants now reach high performance level partly due to the amount of data possessed by these companies BIBREF9.
